model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability scores for mistralv0.2-Base fine-tuned on various specialities. The horizontal axis displays the categories “Per-speciality terms,” ordered alphabetically from Cardio to Pediatrics. The vertical axis represents “Negative probability log,” with a scale ranging from approximately -27 to -22, marked with tick intervals of one unit. The bars are colored in shades of orange and blue, representing the fine-tuned models Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, respectively. The Cardio bar is approximately -23.5, the Gastro bar is approximately -23.2, the Infect bar is approximately -26.1, the Neuro bar is approximately -23.8, the Obstetrics bar is approximately -23.1, and the Pediatrics bar is approximately -26.6. All bars are unsorted and not visually emphasized.
